value.syntax: # [doc = " A completed canonical item's borrowed encoding and already checked head."] # [doc = " Events are provisional until the entire validation call succeeds."] # [doc = " Major type, argument and payload offset use the CBOR head vocabulary;"] # [doc = " the payload includes child encodings for containers and tags."] # [doc = " (´amend:interchange:canonical-budget´)"] # [derive (Clone , Copy , Debug)] pub struct CanonicalItem < 'a > { # [doc = " Complete original item bytes, with no repaired or re-encoded spelling."] pub bytes : & 'a [u8] , # [doc = " Item head offset in the original input."] pub offset : usize , # [doc = " Root is depth one; completion events visit children before parents."] pub depth : usize , # [doc = " Checked CBOR major type."] pub major : u8 , # [doc = " Checked head argument (including a tag number or container length)."] pub argument : u64 , # [doc = " Byte offset of the payload within this item's encoding."] pub payload_offset : usize , }
